doc: Creature voices and movement (M3-AUD-14; assets_src/sfx/creature_sfx.py; docs/kb/tech/audio_runtime.md). Merged into sfx.json's rows by AudioData.sfx_rows(). All on the Combat bus, played by CreatureAudio (game/audio/creature_audio.gd, a child of BattleAudio); creature_voices.json says which creature plays which. Shipped at their targets (voices -18 LUFS momentary max, idles -20, movement -21; tools/audio/targets.py), so volume_db is 0. Rows with variants jitter their pitch a little against repetition.
